nahselitinho utanvhsv kekwani kluhtse nanha wutenhe'i nahski vtali amayulhohti tsikatuha tsekwalani ale newathali unatselikohi
utohiyuhtiyi atolehohski ihsaya tsunhetse'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i
tsekwalani unatselikohi ale newathali unatselikohi itali ititlv tsotani utitilv kelili tsunatalenhvtv yvwi taninelv'i
yvwi ulhsihkv tsaninvki utsathi ikakathi unikohv nano ayohuhihstiyi kehsv utselikohi ale utawatihskv tsaninvki ikakathi uninanukotshelv
nahiyu tsihsa ulenvhe alitsitohvhske'i hi'a nikawehske'i titsineliyvna tetsatanvhthv'i nhakwoyhenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ehskanhiyu taya'i
tsihsanho a'ihsv kelili vtalulhohti tukohe anithali analhinvtli hsawani kwita tsanohseho'i unhvlhino eniti vtali anikyalu'vhske'i'anikaylu'vhskiyhenho kehse'i
hi'ano nituwehsel'i hskinihstawatuka yvwino ihstikaylu'vhski nvtahstvyvneli
kilakwonho iyvt tuniyohse tikayaluti ale kvwahstawatvhse'i
nnhanho wi'uwenv anithali nvwanatale analhinvtli tukohe'i tsimi tsekwiti uwetsi unhvlhinho tsani tsekwiti unitota tsiyuhi unatsa'e'i tanotlhihsihske tsunikayaluti wituyhanvhenho
kilakwonho iyvt tuniyohse tsiyu ale unitota ale kvwahstawatvhse'i

tsihsanho nikvnathv kelili etohe'i tateyhohvhske tsunilaw'ihstiyi ale alihtsitohvhske ohstv khanohetv unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehske'i ale tekhanvwihske tsullenhvtv tunitlvkv'i ale tsutalenhvtv vyuki yvwi unehv'i

tekanotsalhvnho nikvnathv hsiliyi uyhelihse'i tekvwathinhohelenho nikatv tsunitlvki tsutalenhvtv vyuki ale ehihsti uniyilitohi ale nahskwo anihskina tikvwaniya'i ale nahskwo tsunilvnhohthihski ale nahskwo tsuninawihski tunhvwanenho
unitsathinho yvwi kvwhstawatvhse'i nvtayunilohsvhi kelili ahskohinhokatukiyi ale tsiluhslmi ale tsutiyi ale tsotani hskonititlv
unitsathino wtukohv uhsahilhv unhaluhse'i uwenhvnho kvwhstawatitohi kvwaluhtsele'i
aholinho uhstu'ihsv tuweyhonhe hi'a nuwehse'i
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti uyo iyunatvnhateki tunatanvhthv'i unatseliyhenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti uyo unatanthawateki tvketsinuwohihsthaniyenho
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti unatanhvthi katohiyenho unatseli iyulhstohti
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti uniyohsihski ale unithatekihski unatanhvhthi iyunalhstohtiyi tvketsikhaliliyenho
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti unatatolitsathi tvketsitoltsiyenho
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti tsutanvkalvt tsuninawhi unelanvhiyeno unikowahthvti
ohsiyu iyunalhstanehti anohihstihski unelhanvhiyenho tsuwetsi tvkekohseli
ohsiyu iyunalhstanhehti uyo ikekvnateki tuyukhohthv kehsv unihstvtihski unatseliyhenho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
ohsiyu it'salhstanehti iyunho yvwi uhsonv niketsiwehsehehsti ale uyo niketsvnehehsti al nika'v tsutalenhvtv uhsonv kaykoki ketsinhohehskehsti ayv kehsv itsihstvtihskehsti
itsalihelikehsti ale utsahthanvhi ohstv itsatanhvthehsti utsathiyhenho etsakyv'ehti kalvlati nahskiyayhenho uts nitunvnelvki anatolehohski ikvy tsiniketsenv'elv
nihi ama elohi utselika iyuhskini ama yutsihskolhv kato yikalhstohta ama yatolhvna vtlha nhakwo kohuhsti khvhtohti yikaki atinvtikwo uwahsv ale yvwikwo unalahsta'ehti
nihi ika itsathihstihski elohi katuhv uhsahilv tsikakhho'i vlha yeli yvkayekvhskalhvka
vtla ale yvwi anitsvhstvka atsvhstohti alhilohsti yanulhvtihsko'i kakhohtiyihskini anikhahvhsko'i ikano unathihstaneho nikatv kaltsote aniya'i
ika itsathihstihskv tunilvhsattehehsti yvwi nahskino ohstv tetsilvwhstanehv anikowhahthihskehsti ale anilvkwohtihskehsti itsitota kalvlati ehi
lhehsti tikhanhawatvhsti ale anatolehohski tuyohsthanilhv yihskiyelihsehehsti vlhahskini yitakiyohsthanilhv takkhalililhvhskini
utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha khvnhi kalvlo'i ale elohi anilohsonhvha hsakwo uhsti ale hsakwo wuhstikv tikhanhawtvhsti vlha yvkalohi khvnhi nikatiyu akhalitsvha

nahski iyuhsti khilo ayohstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a uhstikhani ulhinetsv'i ale nahski nuhstehsti yvwi tekeyhohvhskehsti nahski uhstikhani akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i khilohskini takhanhawatekehsti ale nahski nuhstehsti tateyhohvhskehsti kalvkwohtiyu akohsehehsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
hi'ayhenho nitsvwehseha itsnho nahski itsatanhvhthi kehsv nititsikonatthanvna ikehsehsti tinowhelihski ale anikwalihsi vtlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv yvketsiyvha
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i lehsti tsatalhvki ale khilo atahihehsti kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinukhotihskiyi

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha khilo tinatanhvlhi ahskakehsti kohuhsti nuhstvtihskvna ikehsehsti kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tinukhohtihskiyi khilonho tinatanhvlhi nitsatanvthvna ikohsehehsti tekalawi'v kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti khilonho tsaneku ikohsehehsti kvwahstvtihsti kehsehsti tsvhskino atsilvyi
nahski iyuhsti iyunho atsilvkelhstiyi hiyohihehsti tsatanhehti nanhanho ihanvtatihskehsti tihstatanhvlhi kohuhsti tselihsehv'i
nnha atsilvkelhstiyi hihiyahskehsti tsatanhehti ale hatanvhskehsti ikvyi ohstv nihstvnehehsti tihstatanhvlhi khilano hiluhkehsti halhskolvtihskehsti tsatanhehti
nulakwo ohstv nihstv tsayilitohi ahsikwo ihsta'ihsv'i tikukhohtihskiyinahsi wiyitsakhahvka tsayilitohi tikukhohtihskinho titaniyihskiyi wiyitsakhahvka ale titahstutiyi yiwtsayvhta
utohiyuhiy hi'a nikvwehseha vlha yvtvkahinuko'i khvnhi ulhskwalvhti ayelhi'iyatanhvhthehti hakhuyhvha
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i lhehsti tsatayhonelvki
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha khilo akeyhv takhanihskehsti tsunanhsihtiyi utulihskehsti kayula utayhonelvhi kehsehsti tsutanhvhthv'i

iyunho hikahtholi hikhahthihsi tetsotehstihskehsti hatakatheto'ihskehsti ale tsatekehsti ohsiyuyhenho itsalhstanhehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha anho unhohstv hiyelv tsvhskino wiyetsta'ineha
iyunho tsoyeni hikhathihsi tetsotehstihskehsti hihskwalihskehsti ale tsatekehsti ohsiyuyheno itsalhstanhehti hsakwokwo tsalikvhalvtv yitsayohuhseha anho unhohstv hiyelv tsvhskino wiyetsata'ineha
hi'a ikawetv iki khilo utali'i ikakhahvhskehsti kanvnehehsti kowheli nahski tunakalenvhv'i
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha khilo utali'i ikakhahvhskehsti tsunhsinhvhihskninonv ikehsehsti utayhonehtiyikwo nikvnhihsanehehsti khilonho atsikhanhvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti
ale itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a tsiniketsiwehsele ethi tsanehe'i lhehsti tsayohsthanv tsahselithanv'i yihowahskini niyatvnehehsti nuhstv tsanetsv'i
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha lhehsti yitshselithanehsti yitshane'ihsthanehsti kohuhsti lhehsti kalvlati yitshane'ihsthanehsti unelhanvhiyenho uwehtiyi nahski
lhehsti ale elohi tsulahsihtiyyenho nahski ale tsiluhslmi nahskiyeno atsilvkwoti ukvwiyuhi utseli katuhv'i
lhehsti al hihskoli yitsane'ihsthanehsti lhayhenho yeli hsakwo kilhv unekv ale kvnhake yinvkahvka
itsinhekvhskini hi'a nuhstehsti v'v v'v vtlha vlha utliyhenho tsinika'o uyokwo kehsv titalenhsko'i
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a ikawetv kehsv'i akhahtha akahthakwo takvwalhvhskehsti khayuhkanho khayuhkakwo takvwalhskhsti
ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsawehseha lhehsti yitsatlekehsti uhsonv netsvnelv'i khilohskini hikathihsi tsahkkweluhvhskehsti hso'i nahskwo hiyalihskolvtanehehsti
khilonho utulihskehsti tsayilitahstiyi ale tsana'ehtiy hawini tsanhuwo uthvnohi nahskwo hinvnehehsti
khilon hsulhilotv ihstenvhstiyi nitsvnhehehsti tha'li iyulhilotv ihstekehsti
tsathayohsehi hinehehsti tsatholv'etiyinho utulihski lhehsti iyvtv ihiyatvnhelvki
itsathvkanvhi iki hi'a ikawetv kehsv'i hikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala hihskakehstino tsahskaki

ahsenho ayv hi'a nitsvwehseha tetsikeyuhsehsti ketsihskaki ohstv tetsinetsehehsti ketsihskinvtihski ohstv nitetsatvnhehehsti ketsinikwathihi ale ohstv iyunalhstanhehtiyi itsatatolihstihskehsti kaykoki ketsinohehski ale uyo iketsvnhi
nahskinho kalvlati ehi itsitota tsuwetsi nhitsalhstihskehsti nahskiyhenho utseli nvto tekananukowhihseho uniyo ale anohstv ale takanvhtaneho unatanvhthi ale uninekutstv
iyynho yititsikeyuha ktsikeyuhi kato yetsakuyvhtahsi' lhahsko nahski yinanatvneho ayelhi'atelv anikihsitohi'
iyu ale itsatanhvlhikwo unvhsv yititsiyoliha kto itstvnehv ttsikontti anhso'i' lhsko nhski yinantvnho ayeli'atelv anikhsthi'
nihihskn'i ntshsknna khshsti nahskya itsitota kalvlati ehi nhskanvna tsiki
itseyhahthahehsti lhehsti yitsatanhehehsti anikhahthahv yvwi ketsikowhahthvhtiyikwo yitsiyelvhskehsti iyuyhenho nahskikwo yinuhsti vlha yketsakyvhsi itsitota kalvlti ehi

nahski iyuhsti iyun hatanhehehsti lhehsti atselhuhki ikvyi wiyhinoyhvlhihstihskehsti nahski tsinanatvneho unatlonahsti tsulaw'ihstiyi ale ena'itahstiyi tekalanvtv'i yvwikwo kvwanilkwhohthohtiyi tsuniyelvhso'i utohiyuhiya itsvyohseha kekakuyv'elv
nihihskini hatanhehehsti lhehsti tsoyeni hikhskani utolehohsv hikathihsi tsoyeni natvnehv'i
nahskino hatanhehv utelihsv kehshst tsatotano utelihsv akowhahthihski uwahsv ahse tsakhuyv'ehti kehsehsti kvnikehsv'i

iyu ale hatatolihstihskehsti aha lhehsti nunahstv unatlonahsti yinitsahstehsti nahskiyhenho ohso uniyelvhso unatatolihstohtiyi unalehtiyi tikalawi'ihstiyi ale tunhvhsiya'nv tekalanvtv ena'itahstiyi yvwikwo kvwanikowhahthvhtiyi unatulihsko'i utohiyuhiya itsvyohseha kekakuyv'elv

nihihskini iyunho thatatolihsthanihsehsti wiyvhihehsti khanvhsulv'i nhakwonho tsahstunhehsti kalohihstiyi hiytatolihstanehehsti tsatota utelihsv ehi tsatolnho utelihsv akowhahthihski ahse tsakuhyv'ehti kehsehsti khvnikehsv'i
ahsenho itsatatolihstihskehsti lhehsti ahsekwo yitsvkhuhthilohskehsti nahski tsinanatvneho tsunatalenhvtv yvwi utsathiyhenho otsinhekv utakalhstohthani tayokatvkaneli anelihsko'i
nihihskini lhehsti nahski nunahstv yinitsahstehsti itsitotayhenho akhahthaho iyuhsti itsinhikvkv ahsikwo netsithayohselvna tsikehso'i
nihihskini itsatatolihstihskv hi'a nuhstehsti okitota kalvlati khehi kalvkwtiyu kehsehst tetsato'v'i
tsakvwiyuhi kehsv wikananuko'i anhi elohi winkalhsta hatanvhthehskv'i nahskiya kalvlati tsinikalhstiha
nitatotakwihsv okalhstayvhti hski'vhsi khohi ika
tikehski'vhsikwonho tehskithukv'i nahskiya tsitikayotsinheho tsotsithuki

ale lhehsti utakoliyetiyi kehsv witihskiyathinhvhsthanvki hskiyutalehskehstikwohskini uts kehsv'i tsatselikayhenho tsakvwiyuhi kehsv'i ale tsalhinikitiyi kehsv'i ale etsalvkwtiyu kehsv nikohilv'i emenv
iyuynho yvwi ketsihskanvtsehv yitiktsineha nahskwo itsitota kalvlati ehi itsitolihsti kehsehsti
iyuhskini nitiketsinhehvna yiki yvwi ketsihskanvtsehv'i nahskwo itsitota vlha yitoketsihvhsi itsihskanvtsv'i

ale nahskwo amalhi itsvhskehsti lhehsti nnatlonahsti nunahstv yinitsahstehsti unatatolihsti tsikehso tikhanhohtiyi nitatselhvnyhenho nitanvneho tunakhathv'i yvwikwo unatolehohihstiyi unatulihsko amalhi anvhskv'i utohiyuhiya nitsvwehseha kekkyv'elv
nihihskini amalhi hvhskehsti hatlonehskehsti ale hakvhskwohskehsti
nahski lhehsti yvwikwo ketsatolehohihsehtiyi yitsyelihsehsti amalhi tsvhsv'i tsatotahskini utelihsv ehi tsatotanho utelihsv akowhahthihski ahse tsakhuy'ehti khvnikehsv'i
lhehsti tsukvwalhohti elohi yitsilhihsihskehst tsihskoyv ale ayhahstlatihski uniyohstohtiyi ale aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi ale uninohskihstiyi
kalvlatihskini witsilhihsihskehsti tsukvwalhohti nanhani tshskoyv ayhstlatihskinho uniyohstohtiyi nikehsvna kehsv'i ale aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi ale uninohskihstiyi nikehsvna kehsv'i
nnhayhenho tsukvwalhohti wtsihv'i ahse nahskwo witahehsti titsatanvhto
akhahtha ayelv ik kathihstihski iyuhskini hikhahtholi kohuhsti nuhstvna kehsehsti nikv hiyelv'i ukhalitshonhvhi kehsehsti ikakathi
iyuhskini hikhahtholi uyo ikehsehsti nikhv hiyelv'i ukhalitshonvhi kehsehsti ulhsihki iyuhskinino ikakathi hawini tsehv ulhsihkikwo ikehsehsti nahski ulhsihki nika ekwohiyu

vlha khilo yeli anithali kvwanalha'i kohuhsti yitokvtvnhihsi yi'ahskakayhenho hsakwo yi'nkeyuhanho hso'i ale yito'uniyvha hsakwo yikanikwathihanho hso'i lahskini yeli unelhanvhi ale mamani kohuhstiyitoketsatvnhihsi

nahski iyuhsti hi'a nitsvwehseha lhehsti yitselihihskehsti tetsvnhv'i iyuhsti itsikihstiyi ale iyuhsti itsatithahstiyi lhehsti ale titsiyelv'i yitselihihskehsti iyuhsti titsanhuwohstiyi lahsko akvnhv utlihiyu yiki ehskkwo alhstayvhti' ale lhahsko ayelv'i ehskakwo tinhuwo'

ttsakhanhvka tsihskwa kalvlo'i anehi lhayhenho yaniwhsko'i ale tlha yaninetsa'ihsko'i lha ale tatanelv yanilhihsihsko'i ahsenho itsitota kalvlati ehi tokelho'i tlahsko nihi utli yinetsilvkwoti ehskakwo nahski'
kkonho nihi tsinitsatvnhv utahsuya uwelihihskvkwo yeli hsakwo iyulhilotv yikhanehkwotsa kvnhv'i'
ale katono tinhuwo totselihihsko'i' ttsatanthvli tsutsilvhi tlokehsi tsehi tathvhskv'i vlha yitunilvwhstaneho'i ale vlha yanihstoho'i
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha nahskwo hsolman nika'v nuwotuhsv'i lha nahski yinuhste tunhuw'v'i hsakwo hi'a nuhstv'i
iyuyhenho unelhanvhi nahski yinikvneha yikhanhuwoha khanehska tlokehsi ehi khohi ika tseha ukitsvnhvnho tikattiyi wunatinvti tsiki lhahsko utlihiyu yinitoketsinhuwotsa uhsti itsohiyuhi'
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yitselihihskehsti hi'a yinitsiwehskehsti kato tayotsiki ale kato tayotsatithahi ale kato tayotsanhuwo'i'
nikatvyhenho nahski hi'a uniyhoho tsunathlenhvtv yvwi kalvlatiyhenho ehi itsitta akthha nahski hi'a nkhatv itsinikhshv'i
ikvyhskinhi itsiyk kalvlti ehi ukvwiyhi khsv ahle utsel'i tuykot'i hi'an nikatiyu taytsihnkwo'eli
nahski iyuhsti lehsti ukitsvnv iytv yiwitslihihskehsti uktsvnyeno uwhs tstalenvtv tvtelhihsthan yelikhwo uyo ika uwhv'i
lhehsti tsitsatalhawhihseli nahskin nihi lhehsti etsilawhihselvki
nahskiynho nuhstv itsatalhawhselv ahse nahskwo tv'etsilawhihseli ale nuhstv itsatalhilohslv nahskwo tv'etsalilo'eli
ale katono ihikowahthihsko utlvtalvtv ukhsuhv'i tihstatanhvlhi nelihskvnano ikehso unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuhv'i
ale kato yikalhstohta hi'a yinhiwehsi tihstatanhvlhi kvlvhsi utlvtalvtv tsakhsuhv'i khvnhiyukwonho unhohstv ata tsvhsv tsakhsuha
tsatlonahsti ikvyi hilv unhohstv at tsvhsv tsakhsuhv'i nhakwonho khvnhikehsv'iyu tsakowhahthvhtiyi kehsehsti hilv'ehtiyi ulvtalvtv tihstatanhvlhi ukhsuhv'i
lhehsti kohuhsti kalvkwohti kilhi titsinhelvki lhehsti ale takvna'iyunahsti titsatseli'k hsihkwa wititsatinelvki yitanalahsta'vlkwoyhenho ale yanakhahthahvna yvketsitakalv'vka
itsithayoha ahse tayetsineli itsiyohka ahse tatsiwhahthvhi itsvnka ahse tytsihstu'i'eli
khiloyhenho tsathayohiho atsineho'i khilonho tsuyho awhahthihsko'i khilonho tsiwikvnhiho atsihstu'i'eho'i
kkokhe ahskaya hi'a tsinitsatvnhv iyunho uwetsi katu yuthayohseha nvyakwo yahvhsi'
ale atsati yathayohiha tsiko inatkwo ykanv'vhsi'
iyunho nihi itsiyo'i yitsihsinahi ohstv kehsv titsinehtiy titsetsi utlihiyu utohiyuhiya itsitota kalvlati ehi ohstv tanhehehsti kvwathayohsehi
nahski iyuhsti nika'v kohuhsti itsatulihskv yvwi iketsatvnhehtiyi nahskiya nahskwo nitetsatvnhehehsti nahskiyhenho hi'a nuhsti tikhanhwtvhsti ale anatolehohski
ahytholhi kalohihstiyi itsiyvhsta ayhahtheniyhenho kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtheni nvnohi ayhohuhihstiyi wikananukokv'i uni tsathanho nanha anilohska
ayhahtholhiyuyhenho kalohihstiyi ale ayhahtholhiyu nvnohi kvnhitv wikananukokv'i ale anikayolhiyu aniwhahthiha
tetseyhahthotsehehsti unatlonahsti anatolehohski awhi uninotena kaneka tsunanhuwa'i tsiketsiluhtseho'i ahsenho hawini kehsv wayha unikv'vhski kehso'i
nuhstv anatathvhskv'i totatsolhihsthani tsiko yvwi thelvlati tanatehsko tsihstunikihstihi' ale hsvkhatha'iyunahsti tsikotsitsihi tanatehsko'i'
nahskihskini nuhsti nika'v ohstv tluhkv ohstv atathvhsko'i uyonho tluhkv uyo atathvhsko'i
ohstv tluhkv vlha yeli uyo yvkvtathvka ale uyo tluhkv vlha yeli ohstv yvkvtathvka
nika'vhskini tetluhkv ohstv nantatvhskvna tikaleyvhstohti kehsehsti ale atsilvyi witatinvti
nahski iyuhsti totatsolhihsthani nuhstv anatathvhskv'i
vtlhayhenho nani'v tsakvwiyuhi tsakvwiyuhi kvkwohsehi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv wuninanuko'ihsti yiki nahskihskini na etota kalvlati ehi atanvhthehskv tsunilvwhstanehi

nahiyu ika kehsehsti unitsathihsti hi'a nvtakvkiwehali tsakvwiyuhi tsakvwiyuhi lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske yotsatolehohske'i' ale lhahsko tetsato'v yotstihske anihskina yitotsinukowhihske'i' ale lhahsko tetsato'v yothstihske utsathi uhskwnikhohti yitokilvwhstanehe'i'
nhakwonho hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli vlha ilvhiyu yitsvkathahe'i utli witsilohi uyo titsilvwhstanehi
nahski iyuhsti nani'v khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anathvkihskehsti ale nahski nanatvnehehsti akhahthanha'i ahskaya totakatsiyalilohsthani nahski nvyohi tsunhehskehe'i
nhakwonho tsukanhane'i ale tsitunohukane'i ale tsunolvne'i nanha atanelv tsituyhilolhe'i ahsenho vlha yuyotse'i nvtshiyenho kakhahe'i
nnhi'vnho khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anathvkihskehsti nahskinho nanatvnehvna ikehsehsti uneku ahskaya tikekatlilohstohti kehsehsti nahski noyuhi tsunhehskehe'i
nhakwonho tsukanhane'i ale tsitunohukane'i ale tsunolvne'i nanha atanelv tsituyhilolhe'i ale tsuyotse'i ale uhskahstiyu tsinulhsthane uyotsv
hi'ano nulhsthane'i nahski tsihsa uhskwa'tv nahski nikawehskv'i unihskwanikohse tateyhohvhskv'i
utselikayenho tsitateyohvhsko iyuhsti kehse'i vlan tinowlhskikhwo tstanatyhvhsko iyhsti ykehs'i
nhakwono tsukhso'ahsv uhsahilhv'i unitsathi kvwahstawatvhse'i
ale kvnhiyukwo atayhehski utlvki uluhtse utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i tsakvwiyuhi iyunho yitsatanvhthelhv yelikwo yihskinvkalv
tsihsanho utoyhanvhitv uhsvnhile'i katanvthvli tsatanvkalvtv kehsehsti uwohsele'i khilakwonho iyvtv atayhehski utlvkv utanvkalvhe'i
hi'ano tsihsa nuwehsel'i kha lhehsti khilo tsihinonheli henakwohskini witsakowhahthv atsilvkelhohi ale alhskolhvhtohti whihvka mohsi unhetsv alhskolhvhtohti nahski unatolehohihstohti
nhakwono tsihsa kekwani wi'uluhtsv uluhtsele ahskohihkkwi aniyawhski tithinhitohi uhstiyethane'i
hi'a nuwehsel'i tsakvwiyuhi tsinvhsitahsti kanka tikwenvhsv utlvka ulvtalv'vhska utsathanvhi akilhiyoka
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i takehsi tatsinvwanehsi
ahskohitskwinho tithinhitohi ti'unhetsv hi'a nuwehse'i tsakvwiyuhi tlhayeli yiniko'i tsinelv tsayvhstiyi hinhekikwohskini uwahsv tsinvhsitahstinho tayutiwhsi

ayvyhenho tikwatanelhohtikwo ale takikhaha aniyawhski nahski tekvkwanelhohto'i khilonho hena tsiyohsi eko'i nvwatalenho ehena tsiyohsi ti'eko'i tsinvhsitahstinho hi'a nhatvka tsiyohsi nahski natvneho'i
tsihsanho uthvkanv uhskwanikohse'i ale hi'a nituwehsele nvtakvwahstawatvtv utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha vlha nahskwo ihsili tuto'v nahski ika'i kohiyuhti kehsv yakiwahthv
ale hi'a nitsvwehseha unitsathi tikhalvkv ale wutelikv itilv tinilohskehsti ale itsulaha ananv'vhskehsti ekwahami ale ehsiki ale tsekakwi kalvlati ehi nanha ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
kalvlatihskini ehi nanha ukvwiyuhi ke'e anehi taketsinukowihsi witotakekata'ehsi tsulhsihkv toyititlv nanha taniyvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhuhtohkv'i
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele ahskohitskwi tithinhitohi hena ale nuhstv tsohiyunhv nahski winitsalhstahsi unvhsitahstinho nahiyukwo utiwahse'i
tsihsanho kwita kanelv uluhtsv ukohe kwita utali'i utsi kanke utilhehvhske'i
uhsvnhilenho uwoyeni utilhvhskvnho utiwha'i tulenhenho ale tuhstelvhitole'i
uhsvnho nulhsthanv unitsathe anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwahthinhele'i tunukowihsenho anihskina khanekvkwo khvhtihske'i ale nikatv tsunitlvki tunhvwane'i
utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsvki ihsaya atolehohski tsunhetse'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i uwahsv ikikihstanelvki titiwanakalahiyu kehsv'i tekitlvkvnho tsutseli nituwanelvki
tsihsanho tukohv unitsathi yvwi kvwatlawihstihskv'i unhetse ihskonv wunilohihstiyi

nhakwonho tsani kvwahstawatitohi tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki hi'a nikvwawehselvki katonho ayv anikwalihsinho yano amalhi tsotsvhska nihino ketshstawatitohi amalhi nanvhskvna tsiki'

vlha ale khilo itse yikalhstltihsko uwethi anhuwokihi kalhstlvtvyhenho yvkatsakalvta anhuwo utatsakalvhvnho utli ekwohiyu yinikalhsta

vlha ale itse kikake'atithahsti tsuwethi tihsulvht yitanitlihstihsko'i tihsulvhtyenho yitatatsakalv ale kikake'atithahsti yatsewoki tihsulvhtnho yitayoki itsehskini kikake'atithahsti titse tihsutlvht tanitlihstihsko'i itsulnho tunihskwanikoto'i
ahsikwo nahski nitkawehsehvki kvniykwo khilo iyuhsti nukvwiyuhsateki uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki hi'a nuwehsvki akwetsi akeyhutsa kayula uyohuhsitena atina hena hiyahsvnhilvha aha tv'atvnhitikwo
tsihsanho tulenhv uhstawatvhsvki ale nahskwo kvwahstawatitohi
kvniyukwonho akeyhv utlvki kikv uwenv'ehi thalatu tsutethiyvta ikvwalhsthanvhi onhitilv uluhihstanelvki kataluythv unhuwa'v uhsvnhelvki
hi'ayhenho nuwehse utanvhthv'i iyunho unhuwa'vkwo yakwhsvnhilv ahse yakwatiwi
tsihsanho ukhahthahvhsv ale ukohv hi'a nuwehsvki akwetsi ukalhstikwo hatanhvhtta tsohiyuhsv tsatiwhsta akeyhvnho nahiyukwo utiwahsvki
tsihsanho nukvwiyuhsateki kanelv uluhtsv ale tukohv tinitselhuhihski ale yvwi taniykv'i
hi'a nituwehselvki itsatanvn nahknho uyohuhsvhi yiki akeyhutsa kalhihakwohskini vkvwayetshsthanvkwonho
ketsinukowihsvnho yvwi uyvlhvki uwoyeni uniyvhvki akeyhutsanho tulenhvki
nahskino hi'a tunotsalhohtsitolv'i nanha nikvnathv tuyhelihsitolvki
tsihsanho nanha utanvhsv anitha'li tinikhewi anihskaya kvwahstawatvhsvki unelhuhkvki hi'a naniwehskvki hskinitoliki nihi tewi uwetsi
kalitsotenho uyvlhv tinikhewi kvwaluhtselvki tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki ihstohiyuhvhskahsko yeli nahski ikvkwatvnhehti kehsv'i' hi'a nikvwawehselvki v'v tsakvwiyuhi
nhakwonho tuhsvnhelv tinikhahtholi hi'a nuwehsvki nuhstv ihstohiyuhvhskv nahskiya nihstalihstahsi

ahsenho unatanvhsvkwo tuninotsalhanvki nanha nikvnathv'i

ahskinanho atsinukowhsv uwakhewi uwonihsvki unitsathinho unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nuniwehsvki vlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti akohvhi yiki ihsiliyi

tkhvno untsathi ywi tuwetlitsvk'i utakalhstohtihskvki wanakwo tanilokv'i ale unatikaleyotsvhi kehsv'i nahskiya awhi uninotena nehvna tsikehso unikhahthiya
nhakwo hi'a nituwehalv kvwahstawatitohi ekwohiyu tlokehsi ukahthvnatsvhi ahsenho anikayolhiyu tsunilvwhstanehi
nahski iyuhsti etsithayohsi uloketv tsunvhstiyi tsunilvwhstanehi ukathvnatselv'i
wituyhanhvnho thaltu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi tunhelv anihskina tsuninukowhihstiyi ale tsunatanhvwotiyi nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyuki
hi'ano nahski nuhsti tunato'v thalatu iyanitv ketsinvhsitv ikvyiyi hsawani kwita tsanohseho'i enitino nahskikwo unhvlhi tsimino tsekwiti uwetsi tsanino nahskikwo unhvlhi

hi'a nvtayuwehselvki nihihsko na uluhihsti tsiki tsikokhe nvwtale otsikathenohehsti'

tinikhewi anikowahthiha tiniyo'ulhinho anetoha atayhehski tsunitlvki tunatiwhska tsunili'ennho anahthvkiha tsuniyohuhsvhinho tekekaletiha uyonho iyunatvnhateki ohstv khanohetv ikekalitsitonheha

i'unennho tsihsa ulenvhvki hi'a nituwehselvki unitsathi tsani tunohehtanelvki kato itsakhahthanhvhse inake'i' wahsonhsko unole uthelvhehskv'i'

nni'vyhenho anatolehohski ale tikhanhawatvhsti anatolehohskvki tsani unanukotsilhv iyahsthi

khilo tekaliluhkehsti uthvkotiyi nahski athvkihskehsti
katokhe totakatsiyatlilohsthani hi'a khohi tsaneha' tiniyolhikwo nahskiya kanhohtohtiy tsanino'i ale tsiwitaniyanihsko unetahsti
ale hi'a tsinitaniwehseho'i atselhuhki okhvhthanv tetsvnoki'elv ahsenho vlha yitsalihskihsv totsiyvhkvki itsathvkoti ahsenho vlha yititstloyilv
tsaniyhenho uluhtsvki vlha yalhstayvhvhske'i ale vlha yatithahske'i ahsno ni'aniweha ahskina uya'a

tunhetselvnho unitsathi khanehskohi kehsv unanvtiyi tukihsvn hihski katu ale thali atsati tunehsv kalvlatinho witukhanhanv ulihelitsvki ale tukvhaluyhv tunhelvk katu kvwahstawatitohi nahskinho kvwahstawatitohi unitsathi wituninhelvki
nikatvnho unalhstayvnhvki ale tunolhvhsvki ale unuthihsvki ulikvhaluyhvhi uthiyvhi thalatu iyakhali'i thalutsa
unalhstayvnhinho hihskiha iyakayvli anihskaya nani'vki nitanhelhvhtvna anikeyhv ale tiniyolhi
khilakwonho iyvt tsihsa tunvwhsthanvki kvwahstawatitohi tsiyuhi unatsotiyi ale ikvyi nitunihsohihstiyi ahsi tayelihihstihskv unitsathi
nhakwonho tuyelihihsthanv unitsathi otalv unhaluhsvki uwahsv kehsv'i utatolihsthanvhsvki uhsvnho nulhsthanv nanha uwahsvkwo kehsvki
tsiyunho nhkwo ayelhi vtali waninihsvki ulhatihsthanitohv ama talhstilhanekv'i unoleyhenho ikvyilv tayukhahthvki
nhakwonho nvhkine iyunatanetliyvtv kehsv aniyawhski hsvnoyi tsihsa wituluhtselvki vtali katu'i a'ihsvki
kvwahstawatitohinho kvwakohv vtali katuki a'ihsv'i unatanvhthehthanvki hi'a nuniwehsvki nayehi hi'a anihska'ihvnho iyuhsti unalhihsthanvki
ahsenho khilakwo iyvtv tsihsa tunhetselvki hi'a nituwehselvki ukalhstikwo itsatanhvhtta ayvkwoyhenho lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti
kwitano unetsv hi'a nuwehselvki tsakvwiyuhi iyunho nihi kehsehsti hskinetsi wikvluhtsehtiyi amayi katu'i
ehena utvnhvki nhakwono kwita tsiyuhi utsa'ihsv amayi katu'i a'ihsvki tsihsa tsetohv wakahtkhi
ahsen nhvtolehohsv ahstayiyu kanolv'vhskv uhskalvki ale ulenvhv kanoyvkv uwelhunhvki tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv utvnhvki
khilakwonho iyvt tsihsa wutoyhanvhitv wuniyvhvki hi'a nuwehselvki uhsti tsohiyuhi katohi vtsatlahsithvhsi'
tsiyuhinho i'unatsanv kanolv'vhskv uhsulkotsvki
nhakwono tsiyuhi unatsa'i uniluhtsv kvwatatolihstanelvki hi'a nuniwehsvki utohiyuhiya nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi
nhakwonho tunihsohtsv kenihsilati uniluhtsvki
nnhanho anehi anihskaya kvwolhihtsv kvwathuwitv tunatanvhsitolvki tekvwahthinohelvki nikatv tsunitlvki
kvwathayohselvknho kataluythvkwo nahskwo unhuw'v unahsvnhehtiyi nikathvhnho unahsvnhilvhi tunatiwhski
nhakwonho tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki tinowelihski ale anikwalihsi tsiluhslimi anehi hi'a nuniwehsvki
katonho ketshstawatitohi aniyohstihsko ethi anehi uninhelhvhi' lhayhenho yitanhsulehsko tsunoyeni tstinalhstaynhihso'i
ahsenho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki katonho nahskwo nihi ethi anehi uninhohelhi itstihsko itsiyohstihsko unelhanvhi unhetsvhi'
unelhanvhiyenho unhetse hi'a nuwehse'i hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi ale nahskwo hi'a khilo tahskintihskehsti utota ale utsi ahse uyohuhihsti kehsehsti
ahsenho nihi hi'a nitsiwehsko'i iyunho khilo hi'a nikawehsehehsti utota ale utsi akwalhskolthanvhi yeli ketsalhstelhvhtohti kehsv'i nitsatvnehv
nikalvkwohtihskvnanho ikehsehsti utota ale utsi vlha uhskanvtsvhi yikehsehsti itsatihsko'i nahski hi'a ethi anehi uninhelhi itsvhthanv ahsekwo nitsvnelv unelanvhi unhetsvhi
itsatlonahsti yelikwo ihsaya tsutolehohse tsitsitvke'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i
hi'a yvwi na'v kvkiluhtseha aniholi antiha ale tunihanekalv tanhvhti kvkilvkwohtiha ahseno uninawhi invhiyu nunnv
ahsekwohskini nanatvneha kvkwatatolihstaneha tsitanateyhohvhska tanateyohvhskv yvwikwo uninhetsvhi
wituyhvnho unitsathi hi'a nituwehselvki itsathvkvka ale itsolhihki
vlhahskini nahski na aholi wuyvlhvhi kataha yinuwaneho yvwi aholihskini nvtayunukotsvhi nahski kataha nuwaneho yvwi
nhakwonho kvwhstawatitohi uniluhtsv hi'a nikvwhselvki hikahthahahsko anikwalihsi uninhalvtsv'i unathvkanv nahski hi'a nitsawehsv'i
ahsenho unetsvki hi'a nuwehsvki nika'v tuyhehkv etota tsuwhsvhi nikehsvna tiyhehihsti kehsehsti
unanelaki tinikhewikw tinikew thinathintohi iyunho tikhewi yahthinhi tikhewi itsula athalehsv tsunilv'ihsti
kwitano unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki tihskiyohsihsahsi hi'a nahski talhilohstv'i
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki ahsihsko nahskwo nihi nitsolhihkvnakwo iki'
lhahsko ahsi yitsolhihka nahski nika'v kohuhsti vholi uyvhsthanvhi kehsv ohskwolhiyi wikaluhkv'i nahskino wikalohihstihskvkwo'
nahskini vholi nvtayunukotsvhi onawiyi titalehvhsko'i nahskinho kataha nuwaneho yvwi

onawiyiyhenho titalehvhsko uhsonv atanhvhthehti kehsv'i ale atahihstiyi kehsv'i ale atayhonehtiyi kehsv'i ale utelitv tinhsihtiyi kehsv'i ale kanohskihstiyi kehsv'i ale atsikhohtiyi tanatayilitohv'i ale ahsotlv'ihstohtiyi kehsv'i
nahskihskini hi'a kataha iywanehi yvwi nitahsulehvnahskini alhstayvhtiyi vlha kataha yinuwaneho yvwi
tsihsano nanha unhikihsv thayo'i ale hsatoniyi wulohsvki
khvnhiyukwonho kenani ehi akeyhv nanha na'v nvtayulohsvhi uwelhunhvki hi'a nuwehselvki hskitoliki tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi akwetsi akeyhv utsathanvhi uteyhahthohtiha ahskina
ahsenho nunhetselnakwo vkehsvki kvwhstawa'titohinho kvwaluhtselvki kvwahthayohselvki hi'a nuniwehsvki wi'ena ikihskonhihayhenho
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsvki vlha khilo titsiwahthvtiyi yvkhinetselv awhi uninotena unalehnlvhi unvhsv ihsili hsitanelvhi kvhsv'i
nhakwonho akeyhv uluhtsv utatolihstanelvki hi'a nuwehsvki tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv
unhetsvnho hi'a nuwehsvki vlha yituyukhohti tiki'ehtiyi tiniyolhi untseli katu kilhinho witatinhetiyi
akeyhvnho hi'a nuwehsvki utohiyuhi tsakvwiyuhi ahsenho kilhi analhstayvhthsko unko'ohsvhi tikvwaninalha'i tunihskilv'i
nhakwono tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki hikeyhv utsathi tsohiyuha nuhstv tsatulihskv winitsalhstahsi nahiyukwonho uwetsi utiwhse'i
tsihsanho nanha unhikihsv kelili vtalulhohti uluhtsvki unhaluhsvnho uhsahilhv nanha uwenhvki

unitsathino yvwi kvwaluhtselvki tanahthinhehv tiniyo'ulhi ale tinikhewi ale tsunvkhewi ale kohuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi ale unitsathi nvwanatle'i ale tsihsa tulahskv na'v tuninvnvki tunhvwanvkinho

nahski iyuhsti unitsathi kehsv unihskwanikohsvki tunikohv tsunvkhewi aniwonihsk'i ale ahuhsti uhstv tiniyelv tsuniyohuhselvhi uninhohstv nunalhsthanv'i ale ttiyo'ulhi kvwanetahsti nulhsthanv'i ale tinikhewi kvwanikowhahthvhti nulhsthanv'i unilvkwohthanvkinho unelhanvhi ihsili unatselika

tsihsanho wituyhanvhv kvwhstawatitohi hi'a nuwehsvki katsiyatolika hi'a unitsathi kehsv'i tso'iyhenho natotakwa ani ketohv anetoha ale vlha yniyheha unalhstayvhti ale ilha yakwatuliha to'unenvhstiyi tikvwaniyohsihski wanayn'o yitaniwankalok wana'ihsv'i
kvwahstawatitohinho hi'a nkvwawehselvki hatlvno yotsiki nahski ika'i alhstayvhti inake'i nahski iynitsathi yeli tsunolhvhihsti'
tsihsan hi'a nituwehselvki ilako katu tetsiyheha' kalhikwoki ilvhskinho tsunhsti atsa'ti unatvnhvki
unitsathinho tunhetselvk katohi unanvtiyi
kalkwokino kt tukhsvki ale tnehsv atsti ulihelitsvno tkvhalhuyki al kvwhstawattohi wtunelk kvwhstawtithino unitsathi wtuninelvki
ale nhiktv unalhstayvnvki ale tunlhsvki ale unuthhsvki ulkvhaluyhi kalkwki iyakhli'i thalutsa
unalhstayvhino nvkha iyakayvl nnhi'vki anihskaya nitanhetltvna ankeyv al tiniyoli
ale unitsathi tuyelihihsthanvki ale tsiyuhi wtsanvki ale maktli wunanuktsvki
anikwalihsinho ale anihsatuhsi uniluhtsvki kvwakoliyehskvnho kvwahthayohselvki tsunanukowhsehtiyi uyelhvhtv kalvlati nvtayulohsvhi
unhetsvno hi'a nituwehselvki uhsvnikalhsta hi'a nitsiwehsko'i ulvhkalyihsatv kehsehsti kalvloyhenho kikake'iyu iki

sunalenho tsikehso'i khohi ika tsiki tvkanhani kalvloyhenho kikak'iyu iki ale ikalokiliyeha itsatihsko'i itsatlonahsti yelikwo itsatolehohsko nuhstv kalvlo'i lhahskonho yeli ketsatolehohihsti yiki uyelhvhtv iyu lhsthanitahsti kehsv'i'
uniyo ale uninekutsitv tsaneha uniyhoho uyelhvhtv'i ahsenho vlha yvkakekalihskolvhtahsi uyelhvhtv'i tsona atolehohski utseli uyelhvhtv uwahsv tutanv'elvnho unhikihsvki
kvwahstawatitohino tunihsohtsv unvkhewhsvhi kehsvki unatenhohtiyi
tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki itseyhahthahehsti aktohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika
uninhelhvkino kehsv unvhsv hi'a nuniwehsvki nikatenhvna tsiki nvtikalhstohtiha
tsihsano nahski utolehohsv hi'a nituwehselvki uhsti itsohiyuhi katonho itsvhsv kehsv itsinhoheha alhstayvhti nitsiyhehvna kehsv'i'
lahsko ahsi yitsolhihka ale lhahsko yitsanhvhtha hihski katu ale hihski iyakayvli tsinani'vki ale iyakhali'i thalutsa itsuthehsv'i'
ale kalhikwoki katu nvkino iyakayvli tsinani'vki ale iyakhali'i thaltsa itsuthehsv'i'
kato tikalhstohti nitsolhihkvna tsiki nahski hi'a tsinitsvwehsi lhahskini katu yitsitvka itseyhahthahehsti aktohti anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi unatselika tsitsvyohsi'
nhakwonho unolihtsvki nuninhetsehvna kehsv uneyhahtho'ihstiyi katu akotohti tanateyhohvhskvhskini anikwalihsi ale anihsatuhsi
tsihsanho ulutsv hsihsaliyi kwlikiyi tutvtvnhvki kvwahstawatitohi hi'a nituwehselvki ayv yvwi uwetsi tsiki kako kvkwohseho yvwi'
hi'ano nuniwehsvki ikatv tsani titawohski ketsohseho'i ikatvnho ilaya anihso'inho tselimaya ale khilo iyuhsti anatolehohski kehsv'i
hi'ano nituwehselvki nihinanho kako hskiyohseha'
sawannho kwita unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki kalonetv nihi kvnhitv unelhanvhi uwetsi
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki ohsiyu itsalhstanehti nihi hsawani tsona uwetsi vlhayhenho ukwetalhi ale kikv nahski yitsananukowhihselv etotahskini kalvlati ehi
ayvnho hi'a nikvwehseha kwita nihi ale nahski anhi hi'a nvyohi takanehskehi akwatseli tsunanelhohti unataluhkv'i al tsvhskino'i tahstuhv'i ehska iyunvnhehti nikehsvna kehsehsti

ale tihstu'ihsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv tsutseli totakvteli nika'vnho kohuhsti halhv'ihehsti elohi kalhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati nika'vnho kohuhsti halhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati
nhakwono tunvhstatelvki kvwahstawatitohi khilo uninhonhehtiyi nhski uwahs kalonetv kehsv'i

nhakwono tsihsa ulenvhvki tunonhelvki kvwhstawatitohi ahse uwenvhstiyi kehsv tsiluhsilmi ale tsutalenhvtv tsukilhiyotsehtiyi tinilawiki ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowelihski ale atsi'ihstiyi ale tso'ine ika tsulehtiyi
nhakwonho kwita iyvt wuthinhvhsthanv ulenvhvki utanvhstatelvki hi'a nuwehsvki unelhanvhi wunvhstohi tsakvwiyuhi vlha nahski yinvketsalhstahsi
ukhahthahvhsvnho hi'a natsiwehselv kwita akwahsohathv halehvka hsetani tihskwotehstihskikwo nihi vlhayhenho yatanvhtheha unelhanhi utselika yvwikwohskini unatseli hatanvhtheha
nhakwonho tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvk kvwahstawatitohi iyunho khilo utulihskehsti akhstwatvhstiyi atatayhihehsti uwahsv ale tsutanhawtv ayihskehsti ale akhstawatekehsti
khiloyhenho utulihskehsti uhstelhvhtiyi kvnhv'i uyohuhsehti kehsehsti khilonho uyohuhsehehsti kvnhv'i ayv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti uwhahthvti kehsehsti
kato yvwi yunhehkwotsi iyunho elanikv utseli yinulhsthanv utanhvtonho yuyohuhselv ale kato yahvka yvwi yikanetliyvhsta utnvto
yvwiyeno uwts takaluthsi utta utseli kalkwotiyhu khsv unwohstehsti al tinkhanhawatithi tthinhehsti nhakwon ttvkuyv'eli nani'v yvwi nhstv tunlvwhstanelv'i
utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwhsha kilo ani tanitoka vla yvtnhatlehohsi ayhuhihsti kehsv'i kvni anikohvha yvwi uwtsi nnha ukhvwiyhi khsv kananuktsilha
sutalinho wnuhsvlhv tsihsa tuthinhvhsvki kwita ale tsimi ale tsani tsimi tinatanhvlhi ale tunhalhuhthanvki inv ikathi otalv unvhsv kehsv'i
ale utanetliyvhse tanikhanhv'i ale ukhathv tikvwalvhsata nulhsthane'i nvto itikvtslitv ale unhuwa'v ikakathv tsinunekiyv nunekiye'i
ale khvnhiyukwo nanha khvnikehsv nikvwantvnhele mohsi ale ilaya kvwalhinohehtihske'i
kwitanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele tsihsa tsakvwiyuhi ohsiyu ani tsitetoha iyunho ohsiyu yitsayelvnhv ani tso'i yitotsilihtsothvka hsakwo nihi tsatselika hso'ino mohsi utselik hso'inho ilaya utselika

ahsikwonho kawonihske'i khvnhiyukwo uhskohstv ulokila unatawatihsthane'i ale khvnhiyukwo nanha ulokilv tsunhetse'i hi'a nvtsuwehse'i hi'a nahski akwetsi tsikeyu'i nahski ohsiyu tsiyelv'i nahski etsathvtahstanehehsti
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv tuninvtse tuniyhahstuhse'i utsathi unihskale'i
tsihsanho uluhtse tuhsvnhile'i hi'a nuwehse'i titsalehvka ale lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti
tunakhanhannho vlha khilo yunikohe tsihsa uwahsv
tsunikhso'ahsitihsvnho otalv'i tsihsa tunvhstatele'i hi'a nuwehse'i lhehsti khilo etsinonhelvha nahski tsitsikowhahthv khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tulenhehsti
kvwhstawatitohinho kvwahtvtvnhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i katonho tinowhelihski ilaya ikvyi takaluhtsi tsanatihsko'i'
tsihsano unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i utohiyuhi ilaya ikvyi uluhihsti ale uwolhvhihsohti nika'v kohuhsti
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha ilaya kayula uluhtsv ale vlha yikvwolhihts'i ahsenho nika'v unatulihskv'i nikvwanelv nahskwohskini yvwi uwetsi nahskiya nvtakvwaneli
nhakwonho kvwahstawatitohi unoltse tsani titawohski khane'ihstihskv'i
nhakwonho unitsathi anetohv uniluhtsv uluhtselvki ahskaya tulhinikwanvnelvki hi'a nuwehsvki
tsakvwiyuhi hiyatoliki atshutsa akwetsi kvliyenho kvwahiha ale utsathi akilhiyoka yanokiyuyhenho atsilvyhi khvhtvko'i ale amayi akvko'i
katsiyathinhohelvkinho ketsahstawatitohi ahsenho uninulvnhvki uninhvwotiyi
tshsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki nitsohiyuhsvna ale itsakahthahvtv kohi tsitseha ilako nikohilehsti itsvyelatitohehsti' ilako nikohilehsti unanelki itsvyelihsehehsti' hskyathinhohihsi
tsihsanho ahskina uhskatsvki ahskinanho unukotsvki atshutsa ale nahiyukwo utiwahsvki
nhakwono kvwhstawatitohi tsihsa kvwaluhtselvki unvhsv kehsv'i hi'a nuniwehsvki katonho tsokinulvnhvki otsinukowhihstiyi'

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki nvtikalhstohtiha nitsohiyuhsvna kehsv'i utohiyuhiyayhenho hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho yitsohiyuha nahskwo atsilvkwo ukhahtha ikhitv hi'a yinitsiwehsi hi'a tsotalv hatanvna itlv whilohi aha utanvhsti vlha al kohuhsti yiketsinulvhvhska
hi'ahskininonv iyuhsti vlha unuko'ihsti yiki khvnhi yvtatolihstiha ale amalhi yakvhska
ahsinho kelili anetohv'i tsihsa hi'a nituwehselvki yvwi uwetsi yvwi totaketsiyohihseli
ale nahski takvwali ale tso'ine ika totv'alenhi utsathanvhinho uyo uniyelvnhvki
kkwaninho uniluhtsv ayelhi atelv ankihsitohi kvwaluhtsele kwita hi'a nuniwehse'i lhahsko titseyhohvhski ayelhi yakhuyihsko'i'
v'v utvnhe'i atanelvnho uluhtsv tsihsa uyohstohtanelvki hi'a nuwehsvki kato heliha hsawani kako ayelhi kvwanakuhyv'eho unikvwiyuhi elohi anehi tsunetsihsko nvwanatalekhe'
nvwanatale'i utatohselvki kwita tsihsanho hi'a nuwehselvki tsunetsihskinikeno unanelakikwo

ahsenho tininhalvhtohstiyi nikehsvna vtali hena ahsuhtinho witsata'ehsvha ikvyiyinho hiyvktv atsati hinehsvha ale hihstu'ihsv aholi ayelhi'atel thiwhahthvhi nahski hikihsvha ale tehinhelvha ayv kinakyvti
nahiyu tsihsa kvwaluhtshelv kvwahstawatitohi hi'a nikvwawehselvki kako utli'a tsilvkwotiyu nanha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
tsihsanho ayolhi wuyhanvhv ayelhi aninv uwekhanhvki ale hi'a nuwehsvki
utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho nitsatanetliyvhsvna ikehsehsti ale tiniyolhi tsinunahsti nitsalhsthanvna ikehsehsti vlha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv yvketsiyvha
nahski iyuhsti khilo utatolihsti kehsehsti nahskiya hi'a ayolhi nahski utli atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti nanha kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
ale khilo thatanilvkehsti hsakwo nahski hi'a iyuhsti ayolhi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti ayv takwatanilvkehsti
khilohskini tekotehstihskehsti hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv nahski kvkwohiyuhvhski utli ohsiyu ahstohski nvy yatsiyalhanv ale ahstvhkv amekwohi yatsikvyhv

un'iyu iyulhstanhehti kehsehsti elohi nvtikalhstohtiha tinatatotehstihski ahseyhenho tinatatotehstihski uninanuko'ihsti ahsenho uyo'iyu iyulhstanhehti nahski na ahskaya titatotehstihski unanukowhihsvhi

nahski iyuhsti iyunho tsoyeni ale tsalahsihteni tetsotehstihskehsti hihskwalhskehsti ale witsatekehsti utli ohsiyu itsalhstanhehti tsoyenhi ale tsalahsihteni tsayohuhselvhi yiki kvnhitv tikehsv wyitsayvlhv anho itsula yithiyehsata ale itsula titsalahsihteni wiyetsata'inv nikvhtlohskvna kehsv atsilvyi

iyu ale hikhahtholi tetsotehstihskehsti hatakhahtheto'ihskehsti ale witsatekehsti utli ohsiyu itsalhstanehti hsakwo yhikhanha kvnhitv tikehsv wiyitsayvlhv anho itsula yithikhanha tsvhskino'i atsilvyi wiyetsata'inv
itseyhahthahehsti tsikyetsihsolvhthani hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika hi'ayhenho nitsvwehseha kalvlati tshs tsuntselika tinikhanhwhatitohi nikohilv anikowhahthihsko ukhathv etota kalvlati ehi
yvwiyhenho uwetsi uluhtsv uhstelvhilv ulenalhvhi
kato itseliha iyunho khilo ahskaya ahskohitskwi awhi yitunalha'a hsakwonho yuleyo'elv lahsko hso'onhelhskohi hso'onhelakhali iyanitv yitikhvhteko'i ale yitikhanaluhsitoho katuhsi yuyho uleyo'elvhi'
iyunho awhahthv utohiyuhiya itsvyohseha utli nika'o aliheliko nahski kehsv iyuhsti ehskakwo hso'onhelhskohi hso'onhelakhali iyanitv nunaleyo'vna
nahskiya nahskwo vlha yutuli itsitota kalvlati ehi hsakwo hi'a tsunhstika kehsv tsuniyohuhihstiyi
iyunho tihstatanhvlhi itshskanvtsehehsti hekehsti hinonhehehsti uhskanvtsv ihstvhsvkwo kehsv'i iyunho itsathvtahstanehehsti hiwahthvhehsti tihstatanhvlhi
iyuhskinino nitsathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti ahsiyvwi ale anithali tehahthinhekehsti nahskinho aninhohehskv anithali ale anitso'i anikahthahi nikatv tsanetsv ahstayohskehsti

iyunho nahski nitathvtahstanehvnakwo ikehsehsti tsunanelhohti unatalhukv hinhohvhskehsti iyuhskinino tsunanelhohti unatalhuhkv nitathvtahstanehvna ikehsehsti nvwatalekwo yvwi ale ayelhikwo'atelv akihsitohi nahskiya hiyatanvthehskehsti
utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha nika'v kohuhsti itsalhv'ihehsti elohi kalhvhsti kehsehsti kalvlati nika'vn kohuhsti itsalhvkihskehsti elohi kalhvkihsti kehsehsti kalvlati
alewo hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho anithali nihi tsitsetoha analikohvhskehsti anhi elohi nika'vkwo kohuhsti anithayohihehsti nahski iyunatvnhehti kehsehsti etota kalvlati ehi
ilvhitlvyhenho anithali ale antso'i tstanilawi'o ayv takwato'v tsinvtikalhstohtihsko'i nanha ayelhi akwatahsuyo'i
nhakwonho kwita uluhtselv hi'a nuwehsvki tsakvwiyuhi ilako nakhskanvtsehehsti tsohstatanhvlhi ahsikwo itsiyatolikehsti' kalhihkwokihsko'
tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki vlha kalhihkwokikwo yikvyohseha kalhihkwahskohihskini kalhvhkwoki iyulohsvhi
nahski iyuhsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiyakwo khilo ukvwiyuhi tsutanvhthelhe ohstv iyunvnhehtiyi tuthukv tsunvhsitahsti
nhakwonho unalenvhv ohstv nunvnelv hsakwo akathinhohele ahskohi iyukwatinvtv atelv uthuki
ahsenho kohuhsti uthahytohti nuhvna kehsv iyuhsti unalha'i unhetse atsinatinvtiyi ale utali'i ale tsuwetsi ale nika'v kohuhsti uhv'i ahtyvhtiyino
nahski iyuhsti atsinvhsitahsti elati utanvne'i ale utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i hskinalha'i hskitoliki hskikhahthita nikatvnho takvyakuyv'eli
nahskinho atsinvhsitahsti unalha'i uwetolitse'i ale uwekhanhe'i ale uthukv unelaki uwelihsele'i

ahsenho nahski na atsinvhsitahsti unukotsv uwhahthvhe ahsiyvwi itsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti nahski unhetsvhi ukhuyv'ehtiyi ahskohitskwi akihsi tsunakvwalhohti uniyvhenho ale uyhvhskiyvhe'i hskwahkyvhsi tsikvthuka utvnhe'i
itsulahanho ketsinvhsitahsti tulahskv elati utanvne utatolihstanele'i hi'a nuwehse'i hskitoliki hskikhahthita nikatvnho takvyakyv'eli
ahsenho vlha yuwohiyunhe'i titahstutiyikwo wulohse'i ale nanha wuyhvhthane ukyvhtiyi atsithukv ikohitv
nhakwonho nahski itsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti unatolehohsv nulhsthanv'i utsathi uyo unyelvnhe'i ale uniluhtse uninhonhele tsuninalha'i nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i
nhakwonho unalha'i wuyhanvhv hi'a nuwehsele'i tsanekutsitv kvnvhsitahsti unelaki kvylhselki nkatv nhi tsktkk hskthayohselv iyuhsti
lhsko nhskw nihi kahiytolhsti yikhse itsulha ehstinhsthsti nhskiy kvyatolits'i'
uthalawhseno unala'i ale wityohihsel tinathsthvhski ukuyhohvhstiy nikhatv atstkv ikohitv
nhskya nhskwo nvhttsynehl'i etta kllathi ehi iyun ttsatnvhtv iytv itshsiyvwiha khsv nititsitolkvna ikehshsti itstanvli unhskantsv'i
hi'ano nulhsthanvki tsihsa uhskwa'tv nahski hi'a nikawehskv'i kelili utanvhsvki tsutiyi ahstv wuluhtsvki tsotani ahskonititlv
unitsathinho kvwahstawatvhsvki ale nanha tunhvwanvki
anikwalihsi nahskwo kvwaluhtshelv kvwakoliyehskvki hi'a nikvwawehsehvki tuyukohtihsko ahskaya uta'invtiyi utali'i nika'vkwo kohuhsti yvtilhiy'ilvhstiha'
unetsvno hi'a nituwehselvki lhahsko yitsikoliye'o nahski titalenihskv tsuwelhvnhvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhv'i'
ale hi'a nuwehsv'i nahski iyuhsti ahskaya tekhvhtekehsti utota ale utsi ale atlawhstihskehsti utali'i ale nahski anithali hsakwokwo unikwetalhv'i'
nahski iyuhsti vlha nhakwo anithali yiki hsakwokwohskini unikwetalhv'i nahski iyuhsti unelhanvhi tsuwuhtathanvhi kehsv lhehsti yvwi yitukalenhvhthanehsti
hi'ano nvkvwawehselvki katonho yhsi tsunhetse kowheli kanvnehtiyi tikalenhvhtohti ale akhehitahstiyi'
hi'ano nituwehselvki tihstayiyu kehsv iyuhsti titsinawhi mohsi unanelaki tanikhetohihehsti tsunatali'i itselihselvki titalnihskvhskini vlha nahski yinuhste'i
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha khilo utali'i i'akhehitohehsti tsunhsinvhihskininonv ikehsehsti nvwatalenho i'atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti khilonho atsikhehitolvhi atayhekehsti atayhonehehsti
kvwhahstawatitohi hi'a nikvwawehselvki iyunho nahski yinuhsti ahskaya utali'i tanatsehv'i vlha ohsiyu yiki atehsvhvhstiyi
hi'ano nituwehselvki vtlha nani'v hi'a tsinitsi wi yitokvnatanilvki kekalihskoltanelvhi unvhsv

anehayhenho aninali nhvwanhsto tsunitsi kvwaninnukowhihsv ale aneha aninali yvwi kvwaninalitvhi ale aneha aninali unvhsv unatanalitvhi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv tilhiy'ilvhstihskv'i khilo tikvwatanilv'ihsti kehsehsti nahski tatanilvkehsti
nhakwonho takathinohelvki tsunhsti tiniyolhi nahski tsuhsihthatihstiyi ale utatolihstohtiyi kvwahstawatitohinho tuninvhstatelvki
tsihsano hi'a nuwehsvki unnelaki titselihsi tsunhsti tiniyolhi ale lhehsti titsinvhstatelvki kvkiluhtsehtiyi nahskiyhenho nunahsti kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv
tuhsithatvno nanha utanvhsvki
khvnhiyukwonho ahsiyvwi uluhtselvki hi'a nuwehselvki hohstv thateyhohvhski kato uhsti ohstv kohuhsti takatvneli akhiwahthvhtohti winahstvna kvnhitv'
hi'an nuwehselvki katonho hohstv ihskwohseha' vlha khilo ohstv yiki hsakwo uwahsvhiyu nahski unelhanvhi ahsenho tsatulihskehsti kvnhitv tikehsv witsananuko'ihstiy thihskwanikota tikhanhawatvhsti
hi'a nuwehselvki kato uhsti' tsihsa hi'a nuwe'eki hi'a lhehsti tsatalhvki lhehsti tsatayhonelvki lhehsti tsanohskihsvki tanatayi'litohv lhehsti kaykoki tsanohelhvki
hilvkwotehsti tsatota ale tsatsi ale nahskwo hi'a tsvhs nitsatakeyuhsv nikeyuhsehsti na'v itihstatala
awinv hi'a nuwehselvki hi'a nahski nikatv takikhanhawatenv tsitshutsa kehsv nvtakvwatalenvtv kato ahsi akilula'
tsihsa hi'a nuwehselvki iyunho tsahskwatihstiyi tsatulihskehsti hena winatuka tsanha'v'i ale thihvhsi uyo iyunatvnhateki kalvlatino wtsahehsti tsukvwalhohti ale thehsv hskihstawatehsvha
ahsenho awin nahski uthvkanv utanvhsvki uyo'iyu uyelvnhvki utsathiyhenho uwenha'iyu kehsvki
nhakwono tsihsa hi'a nituwehselv kvwhstawatitohi utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha uwenha'i yvwi ahstayyu wuyvhstiyi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
alewo hi'a nitsvwehseha utli ahitiyu khemili ukhahthvlehihstiyi yvki kahsnenatvtiyi ehskakwo uwenha'i yvwi wuyvhstiyi unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
kvwhstawatitohinho unathvkanv utsathanvhi unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nuniwehsvki kakhonho yeli yatsihstelv'
tsihsanho nahski tukhanhanv hi'a nituwehselvki yvwi kehsv vlha nahski yinvkalhsta unelhanvhihskini kehsv nika'v kohuhsti iyulhstohtikwo
nhakwono kwita unhetsv hi'a nuwehselvki khvnhiyukwo ayv nikatiyu tokiyohsonhv ale itsvhstawatenv katonho ayv tayotsiwhahthvhi'

tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha atanetliyvhsv'i yvwi uwetsi kanha kalvkwotiyu uwehskilv'i nihi hskihstawatvtv nahskwo itsinehsti thaltu tekahskilv'i tetsukhohtanehehsti thalatu nanilhstalhv ihsili

ale nani'v khilo tsunttsvhi taninelv'i ale analhinvtli ale tsunito ale tsunitota ale tsunitsi ale tsunatali'i ale tsunetsi ale katohi takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti uniwhahthvhti kehsehsti ahskohitskwi unhehkwotsvhi ale unatseli iyulhstohti kehsehsti kvnhitv winahstvna
ahsenho unitsatha ikvyi tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti onhiyinho tsiki ikvyi'ikehsehsti
kalvlatiyhenho utselikohi nahskiyakwo ahskaya kanela hsunale'iyu tsuwenvhse tsitunvhsvhse kohuhsti anatvnehi thelvlati tuwhsv tsunilvwhstanehtiyi
nhakwonho nahski ahskaya kohuhsti anatvnehi tunukohthanv akihsi tsukvwalhohti tsukuhyv'ehtiy hsika thelvlati totsuwhsv tunvhse'i
uwenvhsenho hso'onheline iyulhilotv khalawatihsv'i ale tukohe nvwanatale kanhohtohtiyi anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvhvna
ale hi'a nituwehsele'i itsena nahskwo nihi thelvlati totiwhihsv'i tuyukhohtvnho kehsv tatsvyakuyv'eli unenvhsenho
thaline ika i'uwenvhse ale nahskwo tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi nahskiya ni'utvnele'i
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv thaline i'uwenvhse'i ale tuwhahthvhe nvwanatale anitona'e kohuhsti nanatvnehvna hi'ano nituwehsel'i katonho anhi itsitona'a utotakwatv kohuhsti nitsatvnehvna'
lhayhenha khilo yokinvhsv unatvnhe'i hi'ano nituwehsel'i nihi nahskwo itsena thelvlti totiwhsv'i tuyukhohthvnho kehsv tatsvyakyv'eli

uhsvno nulhsthanv thelvlati tawhsv utselika hi'a nuwehsele atelv ukhahthitehi withiyhanv kohuhsti anatvnehi ale thakhuyvhsi tunilvwhihstanelv'i onhiyi khetsinvhsvhi thalenhvhta ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi thihskwalhvhta
hihskinenho iyulhilotv khalawatihsv ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv anihsiyvwiha akihsi tsukvwalhohti kekakuyv'ele'i
ikvyiyinho ketsinvhsvhi uniluhtsv utli ika'i tayokakyv'eli unelihse'i ahsenho nahskwo akihsikwo tsukvwalhohti anihsiyvwiha ikekkyv'ele'i
kkkuyv'elvnho unikhonelohihsele'kwo ahskaya kanela
hi'a nuniwehse'i hi'a onhiyi uniluhtsvhi hsakwokwo iyulhilotv tunilvwhstahsi itsulahakwonho nvhskiyvka ayv nahski kakehsv ale utilhehkv ika tsokilvwhstanelvhi
ahsenho ahsiyvwi unhetsele hi'a nuwehsele'i kinali'i vlha utsathini yinikvyvneha lhahsko ohsi yitsayelvnhe akihsi tsukvwalhohti kvyakuyv'ehtiyi'
hiki tsatselika ale tsihena ohsi akiyelv tsiyakuyv'ehtiyi hi'a onhiyi uluhtsvhi nihi kvyakyv'elv ika'i
lahsko tuyukohtv yiki nuhstv katanvthehskv iyakwvnhehtiyi akwatseli kehsv'i' tshs hikhatholi uyo'iyu iki nvtikalhstohti ayv akwatanthiyu kehsv'i'
howanho onhiyi tsiki ikvyi kehsehsti ikvyinho tsiki onhiyi kehsehsti unitsahthayhenho ketsiyanvhv ahsenho anikayolhiyu kekahsuyehsv
tsihsanho tsiluhslimi wakhahthv'i thalatu iyanitv anatahstawatitohi unanelaki iyvtv wituthinhvhsthanvki ale hi'a nituwehselvki
kvnhiyukwo tsiluhslimi witikathi ale yvwi uwetsi totaytsiyhs ttaketsyohihseli nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowhelihski nahskinho totvnukhohlhani uyohuhihstiyi
ale knhsilentv yvwi totvniyohihseli uniwelhvnanhetiyi ale unili'vnhstiyi ale unatvtiyi tsutanhawatv kethv'i ale tso'ine ika totv'aleni
nhakwonho uluhtselki tsekwith tsuwetsi unitsi tahthinhehvki tsuwetsi aniwinv elati utanvnvki ale ahuhsti uthayohsehvki
hi'an nuwehselvki kato tsatuliha' hi'a nvtayuwehselvki halhskolhvta hi'a anithali tikwetsi tsunihtiyi tsatselikohi kehsv'i hsakwo hikhahthihsi itilv hso'inho hikhskani

tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsvki lha yitsikhahthaha nuhstv itsithayohihv'i tsiko yelikwo ketsatithahsti ulihskwiti atlihstv ayv tsvtakatithahi alehsko yelikwo yitetsawohsta ayv nahski tsvtayvkwawohsthani' yelikwo unatvnhvki

hi'ano nituwehselvki utohiyuhi akwtseli ulihskwiti atlihstv tatsatithahi ale ayv vkwawohstohti kehsv totayetsawohsthani tsikathihsihskini ale tsikahskani khilo uwehtiyi vlha ayv akwatanhehti yiki ketsinehtihskininonv kehsehsti nahski etota tsutanelhanelhi
ahskohinho iyanitv unathvkanv utsathi unithalhawohsvki tuninikwathilhv anithali tinatanhvlhi
tsihsanho wtuyhanvhv hi'a nuwehsvki itsikhahthaha ayelhi tekolhvwatihsv nunikvwiyuhsateki aninheko iyunatvnelitahstiyi yvwi ale ketsilvkwoti aninhetsitohv nanatvneho'i
nihihskini lhehsti nahski yinitsvhnehsti khilohskini atsilvkwoti iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinvhsitahsti kehsehsti
ale khilo ukvwiyuhi iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski etsinalha'i kehshsti
nahskiyakwo yvwi uwetsi utanvhsitahstiyi nuyholhilhvna tsiki atsinvhsitahstiyikwohskini ale kvnhv'i ulhskolhvtohtiyi unitsathi tikuytti
tselikonho unnhikihsv unitsathi yvwi kvwahstawatvhsvki
kvnhiyukwonho anithali tinikhewi unohulhoti tunolhvki unahthvkannho tsihsa ulohsv'i unelhunhvki hi'a nuniwehsvki hskinitoliki tsakvwiyuhi tewi uwetsi
unitsathinho tuninhetselvki elaweyi unvtiyi ahseno ulhihkwo ik'i unelunvk hi'a nniwhsvk hskintoliki tsakvwiyhi tewi uwhetsi
tsihsano ulewhsthanv wituynvhvki al hi'a nituwhselk kato ihstatuli ayv ihstvyatvnetiyi'
hi'a nuniwehsvki tskvwiyuhi tsohstikatol tsulhstu'ihstyi okinatulha
tshsano tuwetolts tinikatol thsvnelvki khilakwnho iyvtv kvwnikowatvti nulhsthanvki ale kwahstawhatvhsvki
nhakwonho tsiluhsilmi na'v uniluhtsv hsvkhahthi oliwa uhsahilhv'i iyvtv tsihsa anithali kvwahstawatitohi tunvhsvki
hi'a nituwehselvki ihstena itlv na tsvtikatuha khilakwono iyvt tayehstiwahthvhi hsokwilitikali'anvhitv kelihsa'tehsti ale akina athinehehsti tehstelihsatehsvha ale tehskinathinhohelvha
iyunho khil kohuhsti ihstohselvha hi'a nehstiwehselvha ukvwiyuhi tutuliha kilakwonho iyvtv totayuyohsi
nahski hi'a nikatv nulhsthanvki utohiyuhtiyi ayelvhsv'i atolehohski tsunhetse'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i
hi'a netsiwehsi hsayani uwetsi akeyhv khvnhiyukwo ukvwiyuhi tsatseli taya'i tatsaluhtsheli utatolihstiyu ale ukhilvtehsti hsokwilitikal'anvhitv kohuhsti athvhnhehi uwetsi akina
kvwhstawatitohino unenvhsvki tshsa nuniwehselv nahskiya winunatvnelvki
sokwilitikali'anvhitv ale akina tunahthinholhvki tinihsohiyinho tsunanhuwo tunilhvnvki ale nanha unakhilvthanvki
utlinho iyani'i yvwi tsunanhuwo tuniyehstvnvki nvnohi ikatvnho tunvnikalvhvki tsuweyhohtha tetluhkv'i ale nvnohi tuniyhohthanvnvki
unitsathinho ikvyi aneki ale onhi aneki unelhuhkvki hi'a naniwehskvki hohsana tewi uwetsi atsilvkwotiyu kehsehsti yihowa te'uto'v tsikaluhihstiha hohsana wahstv kalvlatiyu
tsiluhsilminho uluhtsv nikhv katuhv unalihthelvnhvki hi'a naniwehskvki kako hi'a'
unitsathinho hi'a nuniwehsvki hi'a tsihsa atolehohski nahselithi ehi kelli katuhv'i

tsihsanho wuyvlhvki uthvnatikalawi'ihstiyi unelhanvhi utselika ale tunukowhihsvki nikatv aninateki ale uniwhahski nanh tikalawi'ihstiyi ale tulhuhkwatinvhsvki tunihskilv atelv tininetliyvhski ale kule tinihskonhihi tininateki unanvtiyi
hi'ano nituwehselvki hi'a nikvnvkowhela akwatseli kaltsote atatolihstohtiyi kaltsote tuto'ehsti ahsenho hi'a aninohskihski uniyvhstiyi nitsvnelv
tinikhewhinho ale tiniyo'ulhi kvwaluhtselki tikalawi'ihstiyi ale tunhvwanvki

nhakwonho nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowhelihski unatolehohsv uhskwanikohtiyu tulvwhstanehv'i ale tiniyolhi unelhuhkv uthvnatikalawi'ihstiy hi'a naniwehskv'i hohsana tewi uwetsi utsathi unihsonvtselvki

ale hi'a nikvwawehselvki hathvkihsko hi'a tsinaniweha' tsihsan hi'a nituwehselvki v'v lhahsko hilvhiyu hi'a yitsikoliye'o'i tsunahsti tiniyolhi ale tinihsta'i aniholi unukotsvhi tsawathvhtohthanv etsalvkwohtohtiyi'
ttanv'elvkinho ale katuhv unukotsvki kwetiniyi wuluhtsvki ale nanha uhsvlhvki
sunalenho tikatuhv wv'akhahthv'i akonu uyohsihsanhvki

ukohvnho hsvkahtha'iyuhsti tluhkv nvnohulhohti nanha wuluhtsvki ahsenho vlha kohuhsti yuwhahthvhe'i ulahstuhsv uwahsv hi'ano nuwehselvki lhehsti ilvhiyu khohi iyutalenvtv yitsatathanhehsti khilakwono iyvtv hsvkahtha'iyuhsti tluhkv uwhayvhsvki
kvwhahstawatitohinho unikohv unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nuniwehsvki nalhekkwo khvyvhi hsvktha'iyuhsti tluhkv'i

tsihsa unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha iyunho yitsohiyuha ale nitsatlahsitv'ehvna yiki vl hi'ahkwo hsvkahtha'iyuhsti tluhkv tsinakvka yinvketsatvka nahskwohskini hi'a yinitsiwehselv hi'a tsotalv hatanvna ale amekwohi wetsatuka ahse nahski iyulhstoti
nika'vnho kohuhsti itsithayohihehsti itsatatolihstihskv'i itsohiyuhvhskehsti itsiwathihskehsti

uthvnnho tikalawi'ihstiyi uluhtsv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhi ale tsunathvhsonhvhi yvwi anehv kvwaluhtselvki tateyhohvhskv'i hi'a nuniwehsvki kato tsalhskahstohti hi'a nahski tsitetsalvwihstaneha' ale kako tsanetshelvhi'
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki ayv nahski hsutaleki tatsvyathvtvnhi iyunho nahski ihskinonhelv nahski ayv tatsvnonheli iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhstaneha
tsani tsitatawohskvki hatlv tsutalenhe'i' kalvlatihsko yvwikwokhe anehv tsutalenhe'i' elhaweyino unatanvhthelhvki hi'a naniwehskvki iyun kalvlati yokatvnhv katonho lha yi'etso'iyunhe'i' yokohsi
iyuno yvwikwo anehv tsutalenhe'i yokatvnhv totsihska'ihakwo yvwi nikatvyhenho atolehohski uniyelvha tsani
uninhetsvnho hi'a nkvwawehselv tsihsa vlha yotsikhahthaha hi'anho nituwehselvki vlha nahskwo ayv yvketsvnohvhsi iyuhsti akwalhskahstohtv'i hi'a nahski tsitakilvwhstaneha
ahsenho kato itseliha' khilo ahskaya anithali tsuwetsi anihskaya anehe'i ahsiyvwino ikvyi wuluhtselv hi'a nuwehsele'i akwetsi hena khohi wititsalvwhstahsi thelvlati takwhsv'i
tsunhetsvnho vtlha utvnhe'i ahsenho onhi unetliyvhse utanvhthv'i ale uwenvhse'i
so'inho wuluhtshelv nahskiya nuwehsele'i tsunetsvnho takehsi utvnhe'i ahsenho nuwenvhsvnakwo ikehse'i

kko hi'a anithali utota unhetsv nutvnele'i' ikvyi wuluhtselvhi vkvwohselvki tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki utohiyuhiy'a hi'a nitsvwehseha atelv anikihsitohi ale tsunatshehsathi anikeyhv unelhanvhi ukvwiyuhi kehsv waniyvhiha teketsikoniha

tsaniyhenho tuyukohtv tulvwhstanehv itsiluhtselvki ale vlha yetso'iyunhe'i atelvhskini ankihsitohi ale anikeyhv tsunatsehsath tsikvwohiyunhvki nihinho itsatolehohsv vlha onhi yititsinetliyvhse tetsatanhvhthv etso'iyuhtiyi

nvwatale talhilohstv itsathvkvka ehe khilo ahskaya kanel nahski thelvlati tuwhse'i ale uhsoyhole kvwathuwhitv ale uhskohse kikake'atithahsti kolhvhtiyi ale unehskehe inv ikathi ale tutholhsthane tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi innho wulohse'i

al nnelihskvna tsikehse'i khvnhi unohukanilhv ale nikatv tunikvtsv nahskiyakwohskini nahskwo nuhstehsti yvwi uwetsi kalutsha

nahski iyuhsti nihi nahskwo itsatvnv'ihstehsti nitselihskvnkwoyenho kehsv iyu yvwi uwetsi takaluhtsi

ale alenihskehsti tokalvnhihehsti itsulaha ketsinvhsitahsti ale itsulaha analhstayvhvhskehsti ale tanatithahskehsti tsuniyhvhstehski
nahski atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi takaluhtsi nahiyu ika ntakahthenohvna kehsv'i ale iyu nelihskvna kehs'i
ale totayukalhsi ale unatlonahsti wanehv wvtayuhseheli nanha taniyhvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhuhtok'i
nhakwonho kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv nahskiya kehsehsti ahskohi iyanitv anathv nahski tsituninvhse titsvhstohti ale tsitunatlohsvhse atehsvhvhski

uninekunho hi'a nituniwhsele anikahthanha'i ikat ko'i itsatseli hskine'vhsi tokvhtlohihsehayhenho tokitsvhstv'i

nahskiyakwoyhenho khilo ahskaya invtswvtikalohsihse'i ale tsiwituyhanvhe tsunvhsitahsti ale tsituyohihsele unha'v'i
ahsiyvwinho hihski iyakayvli atelv tunhele'i hso'inho thali iyakayvli hso'inho hsakwo iyakayvli anihsiywiha nahski yeli ikvwanatvnehti kehsv'i nhakwonho unhikihse'i
nhakwono hihski iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvhse wunthane'i hihskino iyakayvli unhekwotsele'i
nahskwo ale na tha'li iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi nahskwo tha'li iyakayvli unhehkwotsele'i
sakwohskini iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uwenvhse'i wuhskoha katohi ale wituwahskalhane unatlha'i tstseli athelv
ilvhiyunho iyvtv uluhtse nahski ketsinvhsitahsti uninalha'i ohstvnho nunvnele'i

hihskinho iykayli tsatsinelvhi uluhtse'i ale tuyholhe nvwanatale hihski iyakayvli atelv hi'a nuwehse'i hskinatlha'i hihski iykayvli atelv tehskiyohihselvki kvnhiyukwo nvwanatale hihski iyatyvli kvkinhehkwotselv

unatlha'ino hi'a nuwehsele'i ohsiyu hohstv ale hikalhiya etsanvhsitahsti tuyukhohtv nitsatvnelv uhsti tsutalenhvtv tetsalvwhstanelv'i utsathi tsutalenhvtv tsakvwiyuhsateki nvtakvyvneli hiyvha ohstv atanvhtatihstiy tsanalha'i utselikohi
nahskwonho thali iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uluhtsv hi'a nuwehse'i hskinatlha'i thali iyakayvli atelv tehskiyohihselvki kvniyukwo nvwanatale thali iyakayvli kvkhinehkwotselv

unatlha'i hi'a nuwehsele'i ohsiyu hohstv ale hikalhiya etsanvhsitahsti tuyukohthv nitsatvnelv uhsti tsutalenhvtv tetsalvwhstanelv'i utsathi tsutalenhvtv tsakvwiyuhsateki nvtakvyvneli hiyvha ohstv atantatihstiyi tsanalha'i utselikohi
nhakwono hsakwo iyakayvli tsatsinelvhi uluhtsv hi'a nuwehse'i hskinatlha'i kvkathahvki hihstayiyu kehsv'i ale hihskutehskv'i nanha nitsawihsvna kehsv'i ale huthehskv'i nanha nitsalelatvnvna kehsv'i
ale tsihska'ihv'i akwenvhsvki wtakvhskalhanvki katohi atelv titsatselika kvnhiyukwo anhi nahski titstselika
unatlha'inho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele'i tsanekutsitv ale tsatanulhvhti etsanvhsitahsti hikhahthahvki tsihskutehskv nanha nakhiwhsvna kehsv'i ale kuthehskv nanha nakilelatvnvna kehsv'i
atelv tinihskwanikotihskiyi ywitotsane atelv tikwatselika nahskinho khohi tsitsiluhki yitakikohe tikwatseli ale uninhehkwotsvhi
nahski iyuhsti tsito'etsikihsikwo hsakwo iyakayvli atelv ahskohinho iyakayvli tsuhi tsetsi'vhsi
khiloyheno uhehsti atsinehti kehsehsti utsathinho uhskwanikotehsti khilohskini nuhvna kehsehsti atsiki'ehtikwo kehsehsti nahski nahskwo uhv'i
hi'anho kohuhsti kvhtohti nikehsvna kanvhsitahsti toyititlv tsulhsihkv wetsata'uka nanha taniyhvhkehsti ale tanilvtakihskehsti taninhuhtohkv'i
iyuno nhakwo yvwi uwetsi kaluhtsvha uwahsv utselika kalvkwohtiyu kehsv unhuwohstehsti ale nikatv ketsilvkwoti tinikhanhawatitohi tathinhehehsti nhakwo takanhi kalvkwtiyu uwehskilv'i
ikvytilvnho totketsilawiti nikatiyu nunatalehsv yvwi ale totvkalenvhthani nahskiya awhitikhahthiya tsitakalenhvtihsko tsutseli awhi uninotena ale awhi tinihanulvhi
awhino uninotena akhathihsi ititlv totakakhothani awhinho tinihanulvhi akhskani ititlv
nhakwono ukvwiyuhi hi'a ntotakawehseli akhathihsi itilv anitona'i etsena etota itsilvkwohthanvhi itsatseli winikalhsta utselikohi etsalihskolhvtanelvhi elohi tsutolhvnhv nvtakvwatalenvtv
akonuyhenho akiyohsihskvki vhskiyelahsthanvnho akhithatekihskvki vhski'unvnho nvkikhahthahvna kehsvki vhskiyvthanvki
akiyelvha kehsvki tohskinuwo'vkinho aktlvkvki vhskiyakathanhilhvkinho titahstutiyi vkhstuhvki vhskiwahthvhilhvkinho
nhakwonho unatanhvhthi tninhetsi hi'a nvtakvwawehseli tsakvwiyuhi ilakiyu itsvkohs tsayohsihske'i itsvyelahsthanenho ale tsathtekihske'i itsv'unno
ilakiyu itsvko'e netsakahthahvna itsvyvthanenho ale tsayelvha kehse'i itsvnuwo'enho
ale ilakiyu itsvko'e tsatlvke'i ale titahstutiyi etsahstuhe'i itsvykathanhilhen'

nhakwon nukvwiyuhsv atsilkelohi tunwa'v tuwehthsakalvhe'i ahstlv'ihsta utne'i katono ahsi anikthhi ynnheha' kvniyukwo nhakwo itstvkka ahstlv'ihstihskv'i
kato itsliha' unnhetsvno hi'a nuniwehs'i yelikw kwayohuhihsti
nhakwono ukht tunalitshskw'i ale ahskwin tekvwnhstihske'i ale anhso'i tsunoyni tkvwanahsthsk'i
hi'a nniwhske'i hskihyatol'ohihsi kalonet kko tsitsvnika'
kwitno uwole ulanvtv'i ultseleno at hi'a nuwhse'i nihi nahskwo hstethvk tsihsa klli ehi
ahseno niktv anikthahv utayil'i hi'a nuwehse'i vla ytsikathha niwhskv'i
toyilno wulhsv nvwtale ukhe'i al hi'a nituwehsel nnha anethi nhskw hi'a tsihsa nhsliti ehi tanetohvki
thalineno utayile'i unelanhi un'ihsthan'i la yitsikathha na ahskaya utne'i
khiyino iytv kvwaltsel na'v antona'i hi'a nkwwehsele kwita utohiyuhi nahskwo nihi itsetlvhi hiwonhskvyeno knikhsv ntsvnha
nhakwno ulnhe uhskinte'i ale unelanvhi un'ihsthane'i la yitsikathha na ahskaya utvn'i kilakwono iyt tsathaka uyvlhse'i
kwitano untte tsihsa unetshi hi'a tsinuwhsel'i ahsi tsathak nniyvkvna khshsti ts'i nvthskwatyili unuktsvno ehihsti wituloyile'i
sunalenho nulhsthanv nikatv nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinilawiki anehv awi uninhelhe iyunatnhehtiyi tsihsa unihihstiyi
nhakwonho unalhvlv unelihsanawitvhe'i kwanitv kwaleti ukvwiyuhi wituniyohihsele'i
nhakwonho tsutahsi nahski ulonuhelhvhi utolehohsv takuktanelv'i unetliyvhse utanhvhthv'i ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhi ale tsunathvhsonhi to'uyhohel'e tso'ahskohi ayelhi'atelv tsunakvwalhohti
hi'a nuwehse'i tsihskanvki nuhskanvtsvna kikv tsikatluta hi'anho nuniwehse'i kato nahski ayv okhvhtohti' tsvhsv nahski titsalvwhstahsi
ale tutinv atelv nanha tikalawi'ihstiyi ale unukotse'i ale iyvtv wulohsv uwahsv wutatvne'i
nnikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhi tunikihsv atelv hi'a nuniwehse'i vlha tuyukhohtv yikaki atelvtihtiyi yititihvhska kikvyhenho tsukvwalhanvhi
uninhohelhvnho uniwhihsthane vthi tikotlhvhski ulokehsv'i nanha anetohi tiketsinihsohtiyi
nahski iyuhsti nahski tlokehsi kikv ulokehsv anohseha khohi tsiki
nhakwonho utohiyunhe tsunhetse tselimaya atolehohski hi'a tsinuwehse'i ale tunikihsvki tso'ahskohi ayel'atelv nhski na tsukvwathnhi nhski tsatsikvwalothanvhi ihsili tsuwetsi tsunikvwalhohthanvhi
ale uniwhahihsthanvki vthi tikolhvhski ulokehsv'i nahskiya yihowa akwyhonhv'i
tsihsanho katoke ikvytitlv ukvwiyuhi uwolhv'i ukvwiyuhinho uthvtvnhe'i hi'a nuwehse'i nihihsko tsakvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika' tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i yelinhiwi
nunikvwiyuhsvnho atsilv'anelhohi ale tinilawiki kvwayhilitol'v vlha yunhetse'i
nhakwonho kwaleti hi'a nuwehsele'i tlahsko yhahthvkiha nika'v khvnikehsv nanvnehv anikhahthahi ketsatlutihskv'i'
ahsenho vtlha hsakwo'unv yinunhetse'i nahski iyuhsti ukvwiyuhi utsathi uhskwanikohse'i
tilhstayvhtiyinho kehsv iyu'i ukvwiyuhi tsuyohihsehti kehso hsakwo ayhvki hi'akwo anel yvwi
nahiyunho tikanotsalhi ayhvki unikhahe kwalakwa tsuto'itv
nahski iyuhsti nhakwo tunilawitsv kwaleti hi'a nituwehsele'i kako itsatuli titsvyohihsehtiyi' kwalakwahsko' tsihskhe kalonetv tsanohseho'i'
akahthaheynho anvyuhkhvkwo nvtikalhstohtihskv tuniyohsv'i

uwolhvnho tikukhohthohtiyi kahskilv'i utali'i tsutanvhse'i hi'a nvtsuwehsele'i lhehsti nihi kohuhsti na nahskanhvna ahskaya ukvwalhi yititsalvwhstanelehsti utsathiyhenho tsikiliyoki khohi ika kahskithskv'i nahski nvtkalhstohtihskv'i
ahseno nnikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinilawiki tunihstiyethane unitsathi kehsv kwalakwa unithayohsehtiy tsihsanho unihihstiyi
ukvwiyuhinho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i kako hi'a anithali kehsv itsatuli titsvyohihsehtiyi' kwalakwa unatvnhe'i
kwalehti hi'a nituwehsele'i katonho tatsiyvneli tsihsa kalonet tsanohseho'i' waka'tv'vka kvwohsele nikatv
ukvwiyuhinho hi'a nuwehse'i katonho kato utvnelv uhskanvtsv' ahseno utlikwo nika'e unelhunhe'i waka'tv'vka anatihskv'i

kwaleti uhtolehohsv tikvwahsehkokihsti nikehsvna kehsv'i ale unatahsuyetv unalihthlvnhvki ama wnekihse'i ale tuhsulehe unitsathi anikhahthahv'i hi'a nuwehse'i ayv vlha akhskanvtsvhi yiki hi'a nuhskanvtsvna yvwi ukhi'k nihi itsakhsayhsta
nikatvnho yvwi uninhetse'i hi'a nuniwehse'i ukikv ayv ale tsoketsi okinvkalhsti
nhakwonho kwalakwa te'uyohihsele'i uli'vnhonhvnho tsihsa tuyohse akatvtiyi
nhakwonho aniyawhski ukvwiyuhi tsutselika ukvwiyuhi kanelv uniyvthane tsihsa ale nanha tekvwathuwhsthane nikatv hsunatalhuhki aniyawhski
tuninhuwehsvno kikake kahsalena uninhuwo'e'i

ale unihsteyonhv alhstulo tsutsayohsti kolhvhthanvhi unihstulane'i ale kanhsta akhathihsi ititlv unahsvkltihsthane'i ale tanalhinikwanvnehe ale anatehohtihske'i hi'a naniwehske'i itsvyolika tsakvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika
tunalitsikwnho ale uniyv'ele kanhsta ale unihskwalvnihsthane'i
unatehothannnho uninhuwehse kahsalena ale uwahsv tsunhuw tuninhuwo'e'i ale unatvtiyi wunthinhvhsthane'i
uninukotsvno uniwhahthvhe ahskaya hsalini ehi hsawani tsuto'itv nahski kvhska'ihstaki nunvnele uwenvhstiyi tsutanhawatv
wuniluhtsvno kolikata tuto'v'i nahski uhskwaluko'i tsikatka
tsunitsoyhsti utithahsti ataka ahsuyi uninenhele'i unelhvhthannho vlha yutulvhe utithahstiyi
unatvnenho ale tuniyatholhe tsunhuwo anahsahstihske'i nahskinho utohiyunhe atolehohski tsunhetse'i hi'a tsinuwehse'i tikwanhuwo tniyatholvhki ale akwanhuwo unahsahsthanvki
unanvnenho ale uniyawihse
uniylvnenho kalvltilv ulhstathv'i iyuhsti kehsv ulhiyilitehv'i hi'a nikvnhe kowhele'i hi'ayo tsihsa ukvwiyuhi anitsuhsi unatselika
nahskwono itsulaha tekekatvne anithali aninohskihski hsakwo akhahthihsi ititlv hso'inho akhskani ititlv
na'vnho anilohski kakvwahsotlvhte'i ale tanalhstvnhe'i
hi'a naniwehske'i uthvnatikalawi'ihstiyi hiyohstihski tso'ikwonho ika hiye'ilitohi hanehskehski halhstel tsvhsv iyunho nihi unelhanvhi uwetsi kehsehsti tatanhawahstv ehatlo'ahi
nahskwono nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale tinowelihski ale tinilawiki aniyelihskv'i hi'a naniwehske'i
anihso'i tahstelihskvki uwahsvhskini vtlha yvkvlhstelv iyunho ukvwiyuhi ihsili unatseli kehsehsti nhakwo tatanhawhstv e'atlo'ahi khilanho tayeto'iyuni
unelhanvhi ulhskahstohtvki nhakwo wuhstelv iyunho ulvkwohtehsti hi'ayhenho tsinikawehskvki unelhanvhi etota
aninohskihskinho nahski itsulaha tikekatvnvhi nahskwo kakvwahsolvte'i
nhakwonho ika utalenvtv tso'ine iyulhilotv khalawatihsv iyahsthi uhsvhiyeyi itilv ulhsihvhsvki nikhv nahski kathi

tso'inenho iyulhilotv iyv khathawatihsv uhsvhiyeyi itil tsihsa unhetse ahstaya hi'a nuwehse'i ila ila lama hsakwatani' nahski hi'a nuhsti katkv'i unelanvhi akwtselika unelanvhi akwtselika katonho ihskwvhttsvkwo'
ikatvnho nanha anitona'i nahski unathvkanv ilaya ayhaniha hi'a unatvnhe'i
kilakwonho iyvtv ahsiyvwi tuhskwalhvhthane'i ale wunehse tuwoli ale tsunitso'yhsti ukhali'ihsthane'i kanhstohinho uwekwatthanv wunvnhele nahski utithahsti
ikatvnho hi'a nuniwehse'i unelaki itatolehohi tsikono ilaya takaluhtsi tayuhstelhili
tsihsanho thaline ahstaya unhetsv te'uyohse utanhvhto
khvniyukwono anhuwo ayehtoltv uthvnatikalawi'ihstiyi tulhstluyhe'i kalvlati tsulenvhe elati wuhskwatihsthane'i ale katohi ulihthelvnhe'i ale nvya tunalhstluhy'i
tatselihstvnho tulhstu'ihse'i ale unitsathi unatanthi unilhinvtsvhi unatitanehs'i
ale tatselihstv tuninukotse tsulenhvhi nikehse'i ale kalvkwhotiyu katuhv uniyvlhe'i ale unitsathe khvnikehsv nitunatvnhele'i

nhakwonho ahskohitskwi titathinhitohi ale nahski na itsulaha tsihsa kvwayahwhihski unatolehohsv katohi alihthelvhvhskv'i ale nahski nulhsthanitolv'i utsathe unihskale'i hi'a nuniwehse'i utohiyuhiya unelhanvhi uwetsi kehse hi'a
nnhno anitona'e unitsathe anikeyhv ke iyvtv totinikhanhe'i nahski tsihsa kelili nvtkvwahstawatvtv kvwahstelvhitolhi
nnha unatahsuye meli makiteli ehi ale meli tsimi ale tsohsi unitsi ale tsekwiti tsuwetsi unitsi
uhsvnho nulhsthanv uluhtse uwenha'i ahskaya alimatiyi ehi tsowa tsuto'itv nahskwo nahski tsihsa uhstawatitohi kehse'i
kwaletiyi uwenvhse'i tsihsa ayelv'i wuthayolhe'i nhakwonho kwaleti unhetse ayelv'i tsuniyohihsetiyi
tsowanho ayelv unehsv uwetsanulothane kataha nikehsvna anhuwo unekv
ale unvne uwahsv utseli itse titanihsohtiyi nahski uyohi uthalehsv'i ekwanho nvya kalohihstiyi atselihstv wuwehsakwalelhv utanvhs'i
nanhanho ikvyititlv titanihsohtiyi tunolhe meli makiteli ehi ale hso'i meli
ale ukitsvtv atvnv'ihstohtiyi ika ulohsonvhi nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi ale anikwalihsi tekvwalawitse kwaleti
hi'a nuniwehse'i tsakvwiyhi okanvth nahsk na atalonhehski ahsikw tskvnvki hi'a tsinuwhsvki tso'inekwo ik ttvkalni

nahski iyuhsti hineki ahstaya iynnetiyi atselhstv'i ts'ine ika ikhit kwahstawttohiyen hsnoyi yanilki yikvwanhski hi'ano yintaniwehsi ywi tsuyhuhsv to'ulenv oniyino unalnuhelv'i uli uyo'iyu yiki ehskkwo ikvyiyi
kwaleti hi'a nituwhsele'i aniyawhsk ttsikhha itsn nhstayv ikehthsvnti k'e winitsvka
howno unnhse ahstyyu winunvnele atslihstv'i unyelthane n'vyhi ale tunikhane ankathithski
unatotakwonhvhinho khila ika nikalhstihske'i alenihskv hsuntotakwahsti kehsv meli makiteli ehi ale hso'i meli unakahthanhilhe atselihstv'i
ale kvnhiyukwo utsathi katohi ulihthelvnhe'i yihowayhenho utseli tikhanhawatitohi kalvlati tsutlo'ahse'i uluhtsvnho nvya uwehsakwalelhe uhvhse kalohihstiyi ahv'i ale uhskilhane'i
tikhanhohtiyi anakalihski nahskiya kehse'i unhuwa'vnho vnthsi tsinunekiyv nunekiye'i
anikhahthiyanho anihska'ihv tuninawe'i ale tsuniyohuhsvhi nahskiya nunalhsthane'i
tikhanhawatitohinho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele anikeyhv lhehsti nihi yihstihska'ihehsti tsikathahayhenho tsihsa akatvnvhi ehstiyohv'i
vlha ani thika'na tulenhvyhenho nahskiya nuwehsv'i ehstena ehstakahtha ukvwiyhi atsinvnv'i
ale ulhihstiyu ihstena witihstinhohvhsi kvwahstawatitohi te'ulenhv uyohuhsv'i ale kvnhiyukwo ikvyi kelili nvtayehsi nanha tayetsiko'i khvnhiyukwo ihstvnohvhsi
ulhihstiyunho atselihstv unatanvhse'i anihska'ihe ale utsathi analihelike'i ale tunihskwalvhthane kvwhstawatitohi tuninonelvhse'i
ana'ihsvnho taninhonelihsv kvwahstawatitohi khvnhiyukwo tsihsa tunatlohse'i thohiyi tetatakowhahthv utvnhe'i uniluhtsvnho tsulahsihteni tuniniyvhe'i elati nikvwatvnhele'i
nhakwonho tsihsa hi'a nituwehsele'i lhehsti yihstihska'ihehsti ihstena witihstinhohvhsi otsalnhvlhi kelili wunilohihstiyi nanhanho takvkikohi
anha'ihsvnho khvnhiyukwo ikatv uniyawihsvhi uniluhtse katuhv'i ale nunikvwiyuhsv atsilv'anelhohi tuninhonhele nikatv nulhsthanitolv'i
nahskino ale tinilawiki tunilawitsv ale uninhohelhv utsathi atelv tuninhele aniyawhski
hi'a nuniwehse'i hi'a nitsiwehsvha kvwhstawatitohi hsvnoyi uniluhtsvki otsilhinv kvwanohskihsvki
iyunho nahski athvkanv ukvwiyuhi tayotsihstiyethani ale tatsvhstelvhi
tunikihsvnho atelv niketsiwehselv nunatvnele'i nahskino hi'a khanohetv ahsi aninhelhitoha anitsuhsi
nhakwonho hsatu iyanitv kvwahstawatitohi kelili unenvhsvki tsotalv tsihsa unahsehelv'i
kvwakohvnho elati nikwatvnhelvki ahsenho ikatv unatlahsithv'elvkwo
tsihsanho uluhtsv tuwonhehthanvki hi'a nuwehsvki vkhinelv nika'v tiklvwhstanehtiy kalvlati ale elohi
nahski iyuhsti itsena wititseyohvhkha nkatv nunatalehsv yvwi tetsawohskehsti itstihskehsti tuto'v akayvlke'i ale uwetsi ale kalvkwtiyu atanhvto
ttseyhohvhskehsti tsunikhanhawatvhstiyi nika'v itsvnetselv'i kvniyukwonho nikohilv itsvyelatitoha wikvlhskwatihski elohi emenv
